title: Raw pure coface words and contextual coface replacements
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of nonempty finite ordinals and nondecreasing maps [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. For $a,b\geq0$, a raw pure coface word from $[a]$ to $[b]$ is a finite composable sequence of the injections $\delta_i^r:[r-1]\to[r]$ omitting $i$, with $r\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq r$, including the empty word when $a=b$. Words are syntax, not identified by their values. Concatenation places one composable sequence after another; evaluation sends the empty word to the identity and a sequence to its composite. A forward step replaces, in any composable prefix and suffix, $\delta_j^{r+1}\circ\delta_i^r$ by $\delta_i^{r+1}\circ\delta_{j-1}^r$, where $r\geq1$ and $0\leq i<j\leq r+1$. Two words are related if connected by finitely many such steps in either direction, allowing zero steps. Every intermediate word has the same endpoints and consists solely of cofaces, hence all its degrees are between $a$ and $b$.
